title: Принцесса перед свадьбой  (A Princess Before the Wedding)

segments.t: Upstairs in the bridal suite, Eleonora admires Katya in her wedding gown and confesses she always feared Katya would marry someone like her father. She also reveals she will attend the wedding with a charming new investor.
Всю жизнь я за тебя боялась.
На свадьбе я буду не одна.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'You look simply like a princess.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'you' and finishing on 'princess'.
'And you have an excellent prince.' Eleonora brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'prince' in a few short words.
Всю жизнь я за тебя боялась.
'All my life I was afraid for you.' The meaning hinges on 'entire' working together with 'to be afraid' in spoken Russian.
'Just do not scare me.' Eleonora brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'only' in a few short words.
'Although I am calm about you.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'at least' before landing on 'calm'.
На свадьбе я буду не одна.
'At the wedding I will not be alone.' The meaning hinges on 'on' working together with 'one' in spoken Russian.
'Really, and who is this man?' Katya raises the pitch on 'man' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Eleonora answers right away.
'He saved me from bankruptcy.' The grammar packs 'he' and 'bankruptcy' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Now he is our new investor.' The meaning hinges on 'now' working together with 'investor' in spoken Russian.
'And he is a very interesting man.' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'man' without extra filler words.
'I will definitely introduce you at the wedding.' Eleonora anchors the line on 'on', while 'I'll introduce' completes the thought.

'Alright, Mom, I am very glad.' Notice how Russian expresses 'well' and 'glad' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Всю жизнь я за тебя боялась.
На свадьбе я буду не одна.
As soon as Eleonora steps out of the suite, Denis slips through the door with a spare room key. Until next time!

lines.fragment: на твоей свадьбе я буду не одна
